hero.headline: The ERP your Iraqi business actually needs — in Kurdish, offline-ready, in dinars.
hero.sub: Accounting, invoicing, point-of-sale, and inventory in one place. e-Fakhata-ready, with built-in Iraqi tax handling. Try it free for 30 days.
hero.credibility: Trusted by 120+ shops in Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, and Baghdad
problems.title: What we fix
problem.1.title: No real Kurdish ERP exists
problem.1.body: Every other ERP is in English or non-Iraqi Arabic. We are Kurdish Sorani first, fully RTL, with native Iraqi context.
problem.2.title: Power and internet are never reliable
problem.2.body: Our POS works fully offline on IndexedDB — when the power blinks, your sales don't stop.
problem.3.title: Iraqi taxes and e-Fakhata are confusing
problem.3.body: Automatic WHT (3% / 5% / 2%), VAT, and annual reporting. e-Fakhata-ready for the 2026 mandate.
features.title: Everything you need to run the business
features.sub: Accounting, POS, inventory, CRM, HR, payroll, projects, reports — one connected system.
feature.pos.title: Offline-first POS
feature.pos.body: Sell without internet, sync automatically when you reconnect. ESC/POS thermal printer support, barcode scanners, and cash drawers.
feature.accounting.title: Accounting & invoicing
feature.accounting.body: Iraqi-style 5-digit chart of accounts, dinar/dollar invoices, automatic withholding tax, annual filing.
feature.inventory.title: Inventory & multi-location
feature.inventory.body: Item tracking, stock transfers between branches, expiry and low-stock alerts.
feature.payroll.title: HR & payroll
feature.payroll.body: Employee records, monthly payroll in Iraqi dinars, PDF payslips.
feature.einvoice.title: e-Fakhata
feature.einvoice.body: Ready for Iraqi MoF e-invoice submission in 2026 — signed XML, QR code, audit trail.
feature.reports.title: Reports & dashboards
feature.reports.body: Sales, profit, VAT and WHT reports in one click — export to PDF and Excel.

about.title: From Iraq, for Iraq
about.sub: A simple ERP built in Sulaymaniyah for Kurdish-speaking and Arabic-speaking Iraqi businesses.
about.story.title: Our story
about.story.body: We watched Iraqi business owners hack their way through English-only Zoho, non-Iraqi QuickBooks, and paper ledgers. None of them spoke Kurdish, none of them handled e-Fakhata, and none of them worked when the power went out. So we built one that does.
